patent_grounding.rationale: Reviewed the actual cited passages. The gear/shaft/cartridge-bearing arrangement and gear lips are in claim 1 (10553f1f164748383af885f6ee9521dc); bearings in aligned pockets and their spacing/flush/relative-motion roles are stated in the description (069bbc72289b6f4e77337da6f84aedee); the cited pin passage says holes in both gears receive output drive pins (97581bd78c19d221c4ea1af3fa5dcfbc). Command input and coupled-component rotation are supported by claim 14/method description (b9f53b8cb4aedb6ad67f17e9021d7dbb, a7b183cc5a14c40840135ea0517020eb). No unsupported torque-transfer assertion is made.

functional_completeness.rationale: The revision adds both bearing-to-gear pocket engagement relations, completing the previously omitted central topology for each gear. Other described interactions (shaft/cartridge bearing, gear/cartridge bearing, drive pins through both gears, commands, and rotation response) are represented. The rotating external component is deliberately not given a fabricated mechanical route.

flow_consistency.rationale: New bearing interfaces connect compatible inout mechanical_structural ports and reference the existing mechanical_structural flow. The interfaces are recorded once on the ball_bearings subsystem, not mirrored on the gear subsystems. Existing command source-out to shaft-in signal directions/types remain consistent.

claim_traceability.rationale: Structural and behavioral assertions retain patent citations. The conflicting claim-specific N thresholds remain explicitly warned about instead of being consolidated into an unsupported numeric value. No requirement assertions are invented.

interfaces.rationale: Both new interface records have existing mating subsystem IDs and existing compatible ports, use the existing structural flow, and represent each physical engagement once. The prior review's two missing bearing-pocket edges are resolved. The pin relationships are represented once each on the gear side; there are no mirrored duplicate records.

textbook_application.rationale: Textbook guidance is used only for modeling/boundary choices, not as evidence for invention facts. External command source and rotating component are separately represented; the manufacturing/process discussion is conservatively omitted from runtime architecture.

summary: Revision 7 resolves the sole revision-6 finding: each ball-bearing-to-pocket relationship is now represented by one compatible mechanical-structural interface, with no reciprocal duplicate record. Rechecked earlier issues: the pin interface evidence supports pins received in holes in both gears; the prior duplicate-interface issue remains absent; claim-specific N differences remain appropriately warned; directions/types and cited behavior remain consistent. No unresolved review findings.
